biome: temperate forest (large hills, tile 29631, region 'Lanlalium Cliffs', road nearby, no river)
notes: Adviser run (arm on). 3 founders, 4 colonists by day 9 (wild woman Ishca Jean joined). Run ended at daysPassed 11 with all 4 colonists alive (health 83-100, mood 30-72). 0 urgent alerts at run end, but 11 auto-pauses during the run, all on reflex urgents (raid day 6, ally downed day 8, mood-major day 9, Ishca health/downed day 9-10). Research: 8 completed, solar panels 35% at end. Wealth ~19529. Final alerts: Low food, Starvation, Minor break risk (Jean), Need colonist beds, Need batteries, Unroofed electrical, Combatant unarmed, Shaman role unfilled. Two positive quest outcomes (The Ambushed Praetor, Kaleun's Novice Ceremony); mechanoid signal still unaccepted. One hostile raider ('Swamp', Priest) downed day 6; Alex wounded to 76 HP and healed. Ally 'Eggs' downed day 8 and later confirmed dead. Wild woman Jean joined day 9 at 46% HP and was downed on day 10, then recovered to 83%.

quests.name: The Ambushed Praetor
quests.description: Phocas Glabas, praetor of Empire of Eltro, ambushed and followed by a manhunting mink. Kaleun sheltered him at Body's Lagoon; 8 honor granted. EndedSuccess.

quests.name: Kaleun's Novice Ceremony
